problems.title: Integrate a shifted square
problems.question: Find $\int(3x+4)^2\,dx$.
problems.idea: Substitute u=3x+4.
steps: Substitute back and verify by differentiation.

problems.title: Match a tangent’s slope and height
problems.question: For which a is y=2x+3+a tangent to y=ln(2x+3)?
problems.idea: The slopes must agree at the contact point.
steps: Set f′=2 to get x=−1. Then f(−1)=ln1=0.
The line at x=−1 has height 1+a, so a=−1.

problems.title: Local minima of a tilted trigonometric graph
problems.question: Find the local-minimum inputs of $f(x)=\sin(x/2)+\sqrt3\cos(x/2)-(x-3)/2$.
problems.idea: Use the derivative’s sign changes.
steps: Zeros occur when the phase is ±π/3+2kπ.
The derivative changes from negative to positive at phase −π/3+2kπ, giving x=−4π/3+4kπ.
The other family x=4kπ gives local maxima. The function has no global minimum because of its downward linear term.
problems.note: None of the printed families matches the local minima. In particular x=4kπ describes maxima, not minima.

problems.title: A positive local-maximum input
problems.question: Which listed a makes f(x)=x³+3(a−7)x²+3(a²−9)x+1 have a positive local-maximum input?
problems.idea: A cubic with positive leading coefficient has its local maximum at the smaller derivative root.
steps: Two critical points require a<29/7. Among the listed integers 1,…,6, only 1,2,3,4 need checking.
The smaller root is positive exactly when (7−a)>√(58−14a), or a²>9 in this range.
Only a=4 works; the maximum input is 3−√2>0.

problems.title: Length of an increasing interval
problems.question: Find the length of the increasing interval of y=∛(x²)−x.
problems.idea: Differentiate on either side of the cusp.
steps: For x<0 the derivative is negative. For x>0 it is positive when ∛x<2/3, or x<8/27.
Thus the increasing interval is from 0 to 8/27, whose length is 8/27.

problems.title: A local minimum at a cusp
problems.question: Find the local-minimum input of y=∛(x²)−x.
problems.idea: A local extremum can occur where the derivative is undefined.
formulas: The function decreases to x=0 from the left and increases just to its right.
steps: The derivative signs are negative for x<0 and positive for 0<x<8/27.
Therefore x=0 is a local minimum, despite the lack of a finite derivative there.
problems.note: It is a local minimum. The function tends to −∞ as x→+∞, so it has no global minimum.

problems.title: A slant asymptote by division
problems.question: Find the slant asymptote of y=(x²−2x+2)/(x−1).
problems.idea: Divide the numerator by the denominator.
steps: The remainder term tends to zero as x→±∞.

problems.title: A definite tangent integral
problems.question: Evaluate $\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\tan x\,dx$.
problems.idea: Use the derivative of ln cos x.

problems.title: Area between an exponential and a quadratic
problems.question: Find the area between y=(1/3)ˣ, y=x²+1, x=0 and x=2.
problems.idea: On this interval the quadratic is at least 1 and the exponential at most 1.

problems.title: Recover a function from its derivative
problems.question: f′(x)=x/√(9+x²), f(√7)=5. Find f(√40).
problems.idea: Recognize a square-root derivative.
steps: Thus f(x)=√(9+x²)+C. The condition gives 4+C=5, so C=1.

problems.title: A cubic increasing on the whole real line
problems.question: Find a such that f(x)=(2/3)ax³+x²+8a³x+a³ is increasing for all real x.
problems.idea: Require its derivative to be nonnegative everywhere.
steps: A globally nonnegative quadratic derivative needs a>0 and 4−64a⁴≤0.
Thus a≥1/2. At a=1/2 the derivative only vanishes at one point, so the function remains strictly increasing.

problems.title: Minimum distance from a parabola to a line
problems.question: Find the shortest distance from y=x²−8x+16 to y=−2x+1.
problems.idea: Apply the point-to-line distance formula to a general parabola point.
steps: The numerator is t²−6t+15=(t−3)²+6, always positive.

problems.title: Largest rectangle with a side on a triangle’s hypotenuse
problems.question: A right triangle has hypotenuse 24 cm and acute angle 60°. Find the largest area of an inscribed rectangle with one side on the hypotenuse.
problems.idea: The available triangle width decreases linearly with height.
formulas: If triangle base c and altitude h, rectangle area at height t is ct(1−t/h), maximized at t=h/2.
steps: The legs are 12 and 12√3, so altitude to the hypotenuse is h=(12·12√3)/24=6√3.

problems.title: Two perpendicular tangents with the same y-intercept
problems.question: Two perpendicular tangents to y=3−x²/2 meet on the y-axis. Find their intersection.
problems.idea: Tangents at t and −t have the same y-intercept.

problems.title: Volume of revolution of a quadratic cap
problems.question: Rotate the region between y=x−x² and y=0 about the x-axis. Find 30V/π.
problems.idea: The curves meet at x=0,1; use circular disks.

problems.title: Translate a hyperbola
problems.question: Translate x²/49−y²/25=1 by vector (2,−3).
problems.idea: Replace old coordinates by x−2,y+3.
steps: The centre moves from (0,0) to (2,−3); the two semiaxis lengths do not change.

problems.title: Duplicate choices for hyperbola asymptotes
problems.question: Find the asymptotes of x²−2x−y²+4y=4.
problems.idea: Complete the squares.
problems.note: The same pair appears twice among the printed choices, so both duplicate choices are correct.

problems.title: A parabola parameter from a hyperbola distance
problems.question: A parabola has vertex at the origin and opens along negative x. Its parameter magnitude equals the distance from a focus of 4x²−9y²−36=0 to an asymptote. Find its equation.
problems.idea: First find the hyperbola’s focal distance and an asymptote.
steps: In y²=2px the negative opening requires p=−2.

problems.title: A point on an ellipse at a fixed focal distance
problems.question: On x²/64+y²/48=1, a point is distance 5 from the right focus. Find |xy|.
problems.idea: Use the ellipse focal-distance formula.

problems.title: A tangent’s y-intercept from a perpendicular slope
problems.question: For parabola x²=24y, find the y-intercept of the tangent perpendicular to 4x+10y−3=0.
problems.idea: The tangent slope is the negative reciprocal of −2/5.

problems.title: A tetrahedron cut off by coordinate planes
problems.question: Find the volume bounded by the coordinate planes and 6x−4y+3z−12=0.
problems.idea: Read the three axis intercepts.

problems.title: Recover normalized plane coefficients
problems.question: Plane ax+by+cz+d=0 passes through (6,8,1), (0,−4,0), (0,0,1), with d=−12. Find |a+b+c+d|.
problems.idea: Substitute the easy axis-intercept points first.
steps: The remaining point gives 6a−24+12−12=0, so a=4.

problems.title: Angle between two planes through coordinate axes
problems.question: Two planes pass through M=(2,−1,3); one contains the x-axis, the other the z-axis. Find their acute angle.
problems.idea: Find normals using the contained direction and M.
formulas: Normals can be n₁=(0,3,1), n₂=(1,2,0); cosθ=|n₁·n₂|/(|n₁||n₂|).
steps: The dot product is 6, and the lengths are √10,√5.

problems.title: Distance to a plane through three points
problems.question: Find the distance from P=(2,5,−1) to the plane through (−1,10,1),(0,−2,−1),(−1,2,0).
problems.idea: Take the cross product of two in-plane displacements.
steps: At P the left side is −1; the normal length is √(16+1+64)=9.

problems.title: Choose the correct parallel plane
problems.question: A primitive integer-coefficient plane is parallel to 2x−2y−z−3=0, distance 5 away, and meets the negative z-axis. Find |a+b+c+d|.
problems.idea: Use the same primitive normal and solve for the constant.
steps: D=12 or −18. Its z-intercept is z=D, so the negative intercept selects D=−18.
The coefficients have gcd 1. Their sum is 2−2−1−18=−19.
